Julian Newman Doubles Down On Calling His Mom “Fine” And Says He Would Sleep With Her If She Wasn’t His Mom 💀🤦‍♂️

Julian: “She Fine As F*** N***a. If That Wasn’t My Mom, You Know What I Would Do To That?”

Julian’s Mom: “Oh My God. Stop. Time Out… You Trippin.”

Julian Newman Is A 25-Year-Old Basketball Player, Social Media Personality, And Former Viral Basketball Prodigy From Orlando, Florida. He First Became Famous At Just 11 Years Old After Videos Of His Incredible Ball-Handling Skills, Deep Three-Pointers, And Flashy Crossovers Took Over The Internet. Newman Gained National Attention For Playing Varsity Basketball At Downey Christian School While He Was Still In Fifth Grade, Competing Against Players Much Older Than Him. 

Throughout His High School Career, Julian Became One Of The Most Talked-About Young Basketball Players In The Country, Building A Massive Following Through His Viral Highlights And Confident Personality. He Also Appeared Alongside His Family In The Reality Series Hello Newmans, Which Featured His Father Jamie Newman, Mother Vivian Gonzalez, And Younger Sister Jaden Newman, Who Also Gained Attention For Her Basketball Skills. 

Despite His Early Popularity, Julian Never Reached The NBA. He Eventually Continued His Basketball Career At Bethesda University While Expanding His Presence As A Content Creator And Internet Personality. Over The Years, He Has Remained A Recognizable Figure In Basketball Culture, Often Generating Attention Through Viral Videos, Public Appearances, And Controversial Moments On Social Media.
